SELECT s.id FROM prop_qr_exception_record s WHERE s.exception_status='reported' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_relation c WHERE c.relation_type='prop_qr_exception_record' AND c.relation_id=s.id AND c.is_primary=1 AND c.relation_role='source') ORDER BY s.created_at,s.id LIMIT 100

FROM prop_qr_exception_record e JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=e.factory_id JOIN prop_sku s ON s.id=e.sku_id JOIN prop_qr_code q ON q.id=e.original_qr_code_id LEFT JOIN prop_sn_instance sn ON sn.id=e.sn_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.exception_status='reported'),0) reported,COALESCE(SUM(e.exception_status='reported' AND e.exception_type='suspected_leak'),0) suspected_leak,COALESCE(SUM(e.exception_status='resolved' AND e.resolved_at>=#{qrExceptionQueryDTO.today} AND e.resolved_at<#{qrExceptionQueryDTO.tomorrow}),0) resolved_today,COALESCE(SUM(e.exception_status='cancelled' AND e.resolved_at>=#{qrExceptionQueryDTO.today} AND e.resolved_at<#{qrExceptionQueryDTO.tomorrow}),0) cancelled_today
